title: Private Upgrade + Rollback — GA Readiness Checklist (Release Engineering)
content:
Private Upgrade + Rollback — GA Readiness Checklist (Sheet)
Owner: Sahana Iyer (Release Eng)
Release Orchestration Lead: Connor O’Brien
Last updated: 2025-02-18

Legend
- DONE = gate met + evidence linked
- IN PROGRESS = work underway, not yet validated end-to-end
- BLOCKED = blocked by dependency; call out blocker + ETA
- NOT STARTED = no active work
- N/A = not required for GA (must include rationale)

Environments tracked
- INT-STG: Internal staging (shared)
- E2E-STG: Private staging environment used for rehearsal (release-eng owned)
- BETA-VPC-1: Beta customer #1 (VPC)
- BETA-ONPREM-1: Beta customer #1 (on-prem / air-gapped)
- GA-TEMPLATE-VPC: Reference VPC deployment template (Terraform + installer)
- GA-TEMPLATE-ONPREM: Reference on-prem (offline bundle flow)

Overall readiness summary (as of 2025-02-18)
- Core functionality (plan/prechecks/backup/rollback/telemetry): mostly DONE in INT-STG and E2E-STG; Beta readiness depends on final security sign-off + on-prem bundle import validation.
- Biggest remaining risks: key rotation + documentation for signature verification failures; downgrade guardrails for forward-only migrations; on-prem offline bundle operator UX.
- Proposed GA gate: 1 successful rehearsal upgrade+rollback in E2E-STG + 1 successful upgrade in BETA-VPC-1 with backup verification + 1 successful offline bundle import + upgrade in GA-TEMPLATE-ONPREM.

4) Support enablement complete: diagnostics bundle approved + macros ready (Dev / Jacob)
5) Air-gapped flow validated end-to-end in GA-TEMPLATE-ONPREM (Bruno / Hanae)

Open items / Blockers (rolling)
- BLOCKER: Signing key rotation + revocation playbook (Security). Owner: Marcus Lin. Target: 2025-03-05.
- BLOCKER: Forward-only migration rollback behavior + messaging. Owner: Michael Nguyen. Target: 2025-02-21.
- RISK: Backup duration may exceed some customers’ maintenance windows. Owner: Sean Gallagher. Mitigation: document estimates + recommend pre-staging images + consider incremental snapshot option.

Notes to self (Release Eng)
- Once security gates clear, schedule GA readiness review (30 min) with: Vivek, Connor, Sean, Marcus, Kira, Dev.
- Ensure every DONE row has at least one evidence link that a non-author can follow (PR, runbook section, or recorded rehearsal log location).
